headline: Every part checked as it leaves the machine.
label: #d9dee4
visitLine: Call and visit to Croydon South
heroLede: A missed operation or a burr that nobody notices quickly turns into scrap and a late job. Here's what a camera check could look like as parts come off your machines. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every part has all its features: holes drilled, threads cut and chamfers in place. A missed operation is easy to miss in a full tote.
labelLede: Burrs, scratches and tool marks are easy to miss by eye at the end of a long shift. The camera compares every part with good examples your team supplies.
codeLede: Where your parts carry part numbers or batch marks, the system reads them on every part, so a mix-up between jobs shows up straight away.
objectLede: Swarf, offcuts and loose parts can end up with finished work. The camera spots anything that should not be there before parts are packed.
